value.note: verbatim: “(a) Consolidated Leverage Ratio . The Borrower will not permit the Consolidated Leverage Ratio as of the last day of any Test Period to be greater than 3.75:1.00; provided that, upon the consummation of a Qualified Acquisition ... the maximum permitted Leverage Ratio set forth above shall, at the election of the Borrower ... be increased to 4.25:1.00 ... (b) Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio . The Borrower will not permit the Consolidated Interest Coverage Ratio for any Test Period to be less than 3.00:1.00.”

value.value: As of the Restatement Effective Date, there are no Subsidiary Guarantors. The Borrower may (but is not required to) cause Domestic Subsidiaries to become Subsidiary Guarantors (Section 11.22). The Borrower provides a guaranty of certain Subsidiary obligations (Cash Management/Hedge) under Article XII. No collateral/security interest securing the Obligations is stated (facilities are unsecured).
value.note: verbatim: ““Subsidiary Guarantor” means any Domestic Subsidiary that shall have become a party to the Subsidiary Guarantee Agreement as a guarantor thereunder pursuant to Section 11.22 ... As of the Restatement Effective Date, there are no Subsidiary Guarantors.”

value.value: Mandatory prepayment: Section 2.05(b)(i) — pay down to the extent Aggregate Revolving Credit Exposure exceeds Aggregate Revolving Commitments. Events of Default (Section 9.01): (a) Non-Payment; (b) Specific Covenants; (c) Other Defaults; (d) Representations and Warranties; (e) Cross-Default ($250,000,000 Material Indebtedness threshold; Swap Termination Value $250,000,000); (f) Insolvency Proceedings; (g) Inability to Pay Debts; Attachment; (h) Judgments ($250,000,000); (i) ERISA ($250,000,000); (j) Invalidity of Loan Documents; (k) Change of Control (40%).
value.note: verbatim: “If for any reason the Aggregate Revolving Credit Exposure at any time exceeds the Aggregate Revolving Commitments then in effect, the Borrower shall immediately prepay Revolving Loans and/or Swing Line Loans and/or Cash Collateralize the L/C Exposure in an aggregate amount equal to such excess”

value.note: verbatim: “to secure the prompt payment and performance in full when due ... of the Secured Obligations (as defined in the Security Agreement), such New Loan Party hereby grants, pledges and assigns to the Administrative Agent, for the benefit of the holders of the Secured Obligations, a continuing security interest in, and a right of set off against any and all right, title and interest of such New Loan Party in and to the Collateral”

value.value: Mandatory prepayments: (i) Total Revolving Outstandings exceeding Aggregate Revolving Commitments; (ii) 100% of Net Cash Proceeds from Material Dispositions / Material Recovery Events (subject to 365-day reinvestment); (iii) 100% of Net Cash Proceeds of Debt Issuances. Events of Default set forth in Section 9.01 include Non-Payment, breach of Specific Covenants, Other Defaults, Representations and Warranties, Cross-Default (Material Indebtedness), Insolvency Proceedings, Inability to Pay Debts/Attachment, Judgments, ERISA, Invalidity of Loan Documents, Change of Control, Invalidity of Subordination Provisions
value.note: verbatim: “(b) Mandatory Prepayments of Loans . (i) Revolving Commitments . If for any reason the Total Revolving Outstandings at any time exceed the Aggregate Revolving Commitments then in effect, the Borrower shall immediately prepay ... (ii) Dispositions and Recovery Events . The Borrower shall prepay the Loans ... in an aggregate amount equal to 100% of the Net Cash Proceeds received by any Loan Party from any Material Disposition or Material Recovery Event ... (iii) Debt Issuances . Immediately upon receipt by any Loan Party of the Net Cash Proceeds of any Debt Issuance by any Loan Party, the Borrower shall prepay the Loans ... in an aggregate amount equal to 100% of such Net Cash Proceeds.”
